title: 第二十五章 仙经第二十六章 我居然没有灵根
slug: 废灵根修炼慢但我长生不死啊
lines: 他们对那些金银珠宝没有任何兴趣，径直来到了书架前。
“炼丹散记、灵药图录、修行百解，灵兽培养手册，都是好东西啊！”
“这是丹炉炼制之法？”
李水生正看得入迷，旁边忽然响起石傲激动的声音。
“师弟，快来看，这是那两个金甲武士的控制之法！”
李水生快步过去，接过一看，“金甲符兵？”
“摄魂钟？”
“用血涂抹在小钟上，便能让两个金甲符兵听令？”
李水生当即挤出一滴鲜血，滴在小钟上。
下一刻，李水生感受到了两个陌生的朦胧意识，就在自己左右两边。
“你们两人且听好，侍奉本座六十年，我便释放你们两人，入土为安，可好？”
两个金甲武士，铿锵一声跪地。
白崇安带着人和马车回来，“前辈，我已经将人和马车带来了，运哪些？”
李水生道：“来不及细看了，全部带走！”
“离开此地，再细细分辨。”
“对了，将那条大狗，还有那童子也带上。”
一行人收拾半日，搬空了整个国师府，足足装了二十辆马车。
天色将黑，李水生挥鞭落在马背上，马匹吃痛，快步奔跑。
远处城墙之上一色的漆黑铁甲军，手持长弓虎视眈眈。
李水生冷笑一声，提锤下车。
还没等城墙上的铁甲军反应过来，李水生挥动飞星锤，好似苍空坠星般砸下。
轰隆隆！
城墙被一锤打得碎裂开，露出一条路来。
宗师之威，显露无疑。
“不想死的，就给我老实点！”
“区区一两千人，本座还不放在眼里！”
铁甲军看到这般盖世神威，吓得弓都有些拉不开了，哪里还敢阻拦。
“放他们走！”
“如今最要紧的，是从龙之功！”
一行人踩着夜色出了城，远离京城二十里，这才开始停下来休息。
白崇安提着个脑袋过来，“前辈，有几个跟踪的探子，被我解决了。”
李水生道：“很好。”
“前辈，我们去哪儿？”
content_en:
They had no interest in the gold and silver jewelry and went straight to the bookshelf.
"Alchemy notes, elixir illustrations, spiritual practice guides, and spiritual beast training manuals are all great things!"
"Is this the alchemy furnace refining method?"
Li Shuisheng was looking at it in fascination when Shi Ao's excited voice suddenly sounded next to him.
"Junior brother, come and see, this is the control method of the two golden armored warriors!"
Li Shuisheng walked over quickly, took it and took a look, "Golden Armored Talisman Soldier?"
"The Soul-Calling Bell?"
"Smearing blood on the small bell can make two golden armored talisman soldiers obey orders?"
Li Shuisheng immediately squeezed out a drop of blood and dropped it on the small clock.
The next moment, Li Shuisheng felt two unfamiliar hazy consciousnesses on his left and right sides.
"Listen carefully, you two. After you have served me for sixty years, I will release you two and rest in peace, okay?"
The two golden-armored warriors knelt down with a clanging sound.
Bai Chongan came back with the people and carriage, "Senior, I have brought the people and carriage, what should I transport?"
Li Shuisheng said: "It's too late to take a closer look, take them all away!"
"Leave this place and distinguish it carefully."
"By the way, bring the big dog and the boy with you."
After half a day of cleaning up, the group evacuated the entire Imperial Preceptor's Mansion and loaded twenty carriages into it.
It was getting dark when Li Shuisheng whipped his whip and fell on the horse. The horse was in pain and ran quickly.
A dark armored army stood on the city wall in the distance, holding long bows and looking at them eagerly.
Li Shuisheng sneered, picked up the hammer and got out of the car.
Before the armored soldiers on the city wall could react, Li Shuisheng swung the flying star hammer and it hit it like a falling star from the sky.
Boom!
The city wall was shattered with a hammer, revealing a road.
The power of the Grandmaster is undoubtedly revealed.
"If you don't want to die, just be honest!"
"There are only one or two thousand people, but I still don't take them seriously!"
Seeing such unparalleled power, the armored soldiers were so frightened that they couldn't even draw their bows, and they dared to stop him.
"Let them go!"
"The most important thing now is the power of Conglong!"
The group of people walked out of the city in the night, twenty miles away from the capital, and then stopped to rest.
Bai Chongan came over with his head raised, "Senior, there were several spies who were following us, but I took care of them."
Li Shuisheng said: "Very good."
"Senior, where are we going?"
title_en: Chapter 25 Immortal Sutra Chapter 26 I actually have no spiritual roots
